assets.logo_primary: n/a - no durable logo asset is currently owned by this repository
assets.logo_compact: n/a - no compact logo variant is currently owned by this repository
assets.logo_monochrome: n/a - no monochrome logo variant is currently owned by this repository
assets.app_icon: n/a - launcher icon is intentionally deferred until a durable brand asset is approved

tokens.typography: app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/daniele21/redactguard/ui/theme/RedactGuardTheme.kt; system sans-serif with Material 3 scale and restrained weight contrast
tokens.radius: Material 3 semantic shapes: 8 dp small, 12 dp medium, 16 dp large
tokens.elevation: minimal; prefer grouping/spacing before elevation, status surfaces use low tonal elevation only

style.iconography: Material symbols/icons only when they improve scanning or action recognition; never use an icon as the sole carrier of critical meaning without semantics
style.motion: quiet, functional and brief; motion communicates state, continuity, progress or completion and never delays a privacy/recovery action
style.imagery: functional-before-decorative; no illustration is required to understand the document protection workflow
style.voice_microcopy: calm, direct Italian task language; state what happens locally, avoid backend vocabulary on normal surfaces, explain known failures and the next action without alarmist language

durations.large: 300 ms maximum for infrequent navigation/meaningful completion

spring.default: medium-low stiffness, no visible overshoot for task UI
spring.bounce: n/a - decorative bounce is not part of the RedactGuard motion language

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: replace non-essential animated transitions with immediate state changes; never remove acknowledgement, progress text or outcome feedback
